notes.title: Game controls
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Since I'm getting a lot of questions related to game controls, here is a small instruction.

I'm skipping mouse, because it seems intuitive enough :)

As for gamepads. They must support XInput API or in other words must be XBox compatible gamepads.

[b]Menu[/b]

Keyboard:
[i]Arrow keys[/i] for navigation. [i]Enter[/i] for pressing items.
For volume bars and Level editor tanks selection [i]Left and Right arrow keys[/i] can be used.

Gamepad:
[i]Left stick[/i], [i]Right stick[/i] or [i]D-pad[/i] for navigation. [i]A[/i], [i]B[/i], [i]X[/i], [i]Y[/i] (XBox gamepad) for pressing items.
For volume bars and Level editor tanks selection Left and Right directions of [i]sticks[/i] or [i]D-pad[/i] can be used.


[b]Game[/b]

Keyboard
Can be used for 1 or 2 players.
Player 1: [i]arrow keys[/i] for movement, [i]Space[/i] for shooting
Player 2: [i]WASD[/i] for movement, [i]left CTRL[/i] for shooting.
Press [i]Escape[/i] for pause + menu.

Gamepad:
[i]Left stick[/i], [i]Right stick[/i] or [i]D-pad[/i] for movement. [i]A[/i], [i]B[/i] (XBox gamepad) or [i]Right shoulder trigger[/i] for shooting.
[i]Start[/i] or [i]Back[/i] (XBox gamepad) for pause + menu.


[b]Level list[/b]

Keyboard:
[i]Arrow keys[/i] for navigation or selecting item action. [i]Enter[/i] for opening item actions.
Press [i]Escape[/i] for menu.

[i]Left stick[/i], [i]Right stick[/i] or [i]D-pad[/i] for navigation or selecting item action. [i]A[/i], [i]B[/i], [i]X[/i], [i]Y[/i] (XBox gamepad) for opening item actions.


[b]Level editor[/b]

Keyboard
[i]Arrow keys[/i] for cursor movement. [i]Space[/i] for placing object or using erase.
[i]PageUp[/i]/[i]PageDown[/i] for switching current object.
Press [i]Escape[/i] for menu.

Gamepad
[i]Left stick[/i], [i]Right stick[/i] or [i]D-pad[/i] for cursor movement. [i]A[/i] (XBox gamepad) for placing object or erasing. [i]X[/i], [i]B[/i] (XBox gamepad), [i]Left/Right shoulder button[/i] for switching current object.
[i]Start[/i] or [i]Back[/i] (XBox gamepad) for menu.

notes.title: New version released
notes.notes:
Hi all!

New version of TANKS is released.

There are following small improvements:
- Last session is now stored and it is possible to continue playing from last non-completed level restoring player stats. But beware, starting new game and completing first level will overwrite save data. Let's see if this new feature works good enough
- Friendly fire setting in Options
- Possibility to control Pause and all menus using also second gamepad
- Small change in launching procedure to likely fix a rare issue when game starts without appearing on desktop/screen.
- Hopefully no new bugs added
